sections.heading: Verdict shape for Outreach
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Yes for teams where Mid-market/enterprise teams whose primary job is sales engagement sequencing + CRM sync matter more than polish elsewhere. Counter-signal: No when Compare Salesloft as the SEP peer; Apollo/Reply for data+engage SMB stacks; Instantly for cold-email infra; ZoomInfo/Apollo when contact data is the primary job..

Capability hinge for this product: contact data; prospecting; data enrichment; email outreach.

Integrations in research: Salesforce, HubSpot, Gong, Slack.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Amplify Essentials, Amplify Core, Amplify Plus.

sections.heading: Who Outreach is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose Outreach when enterprise sales engagement, CRM sync, and AI revenue workflows are the job — not when you need a contact database..

Avoid if: Compare Salesloft as the SEP peer; Apollo/Reply for data+engage SMB stacks; Instantly for cold-email infra; ZoomInfo/Apollo when contact data is the primary job..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Salesloft on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: Outreach price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Data depth / intent specialization vs outreach execution built-in.

Next step: run contact data end-to-end, then decide.
